title: Passive voice: present & past simple · 被动语态（一般现在时/一般过去时）
pattern: Object + am / is / are / was / were + Past participle + (by Agent)
summary: 当动作的承受者比执行者更重要时，用 be + 过去分词：The window was broken.
explanation: **主动句**强调“谁做了什么”：The kids ate the cake。**被动句**把动作的承受者放到句首，强调“什么事发生了”：The cake **was eaten** (by the kids)。
构成公式：**be + 过去分词（V3）**。be 动词要和新主语的人称、数以及时态一致：The room **is** cleaned every day.（一般现在时）/ The rooms **were** cleaned yesterday.（一般过去时）。
把主动句改成被动句只需三步：① 宾语变主语；② 动词变成 be + V3（be 的时态与原句动词一致）；③ 原主语放到 **by** 后面——如果它不重要、不知道或显而易见，就直接省略。
什么时候用被动？执行者不明或不重要（My bike **was stolen**.）、想强调结果（The bridge **was built** in 1990.）、正式书面语和说明文（Rice **is grown** in southern China.）。
和中文“被”字句不同，英语被动句**非常常见**，而且并不限于不好的事情。中文常用“主动形式表被动意思”（门开了），英语则必须写成 The door **was opened** / **is closed** 这类形式。
mistakes: ✗ The window broke by him. → ✓ The window was broken by him. 被动句不能漏掉 be 动词，且动词必须用过去分词（broken，不是 broke）。
✗ English is speaking here. → ✓ English is spoken here. 被动句要用过去分词 spoken，而不是 -ing 形式。
✗ The accident was happened last night. → ✓ The accident happened last night. happen、arrive、die、fall 等不及物动词没有被动语态。
✗ The cake was ate by the kids. → ✓ The cake was eaten by the kids. 不规则动词要记住过去分词：eat → eaten，write → written。

examples.text: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.note: 执行者是“人们”，不重要，所以省略 by。

examples.text: The room is cleaned every day.
My phone was stolen on the bus.
examples.translation: 我的手机在公交车上被偷了。
examples.note: 不知道是谁偷的，所以不写 by。

examples.text: These photos were taken by my sister.
examples.translation: 这些照片是我姐姐拍的。
examples.note: 执行者有新信息价值，所以保留 by my sister。

examples.text: Tea is grown in the south of China.
The letters were not delivered on time.

exercises.explanation: yesterday 表示过去，所以用 was + 过去分词 sent。

exercises.sentence: Many cars ___ in this factory every year.
exercises.translation: 这家工厂每年生产很多汽车。
exercises.explanation: 主语 cars 是复数，every year 表示一般现在时：are made。

exercises.sentence: The museum ___ by thousands of visitors last month.
exercises.translation: 上个月有数千名游客参观了这座博物馆。
exercises.explanation: last month 是过去，主语 museum 是单数：was visited。
过去的事件用 was built；built 是 build 的过去分词。

exercises.source: 这些书在中国是不卖的。
options: These books are not sold in China.
These books not sell in China.
These books are not selling in China.
These books does not sold in China.
exercises.explanation: 一般现在时被动语态的否定：are not + sold。

options: The window was broken by a ball.
The accident was happened at night.
The cake was eaten by the kids.
exercises.explanation: happen 是不及物动词，不能用被动语态，应写成 The accident happened at night.

options: Rice is grown in many countries.
The report was written last week.
exercises.explanation: 被动语态要用过去分词：Spanish is spoken in Mexico.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.explanation: 被动句结构：主语 + was + 过去分词 + by + 执行者。

exercises.explanation: 一般现在时被动语态：is / are + 过去分词。
